title: Closeout summary: Property tests for gap emission coverage
body:
Subject: work:bw_work_5ee1f40e4cb70e99
Status: verified
Priority: normal

## Outcome

WHY: the gap contract is only trustworthy if emission is total - a policy violation without a gap code is a directive that can never fire after the inversion. WHAT: add a test layer that drives the runtime through every enforcement path (close without verification, close with open gates per gate kind and scope, reserve non-ready work, reserve at capacity, verify with mismatched evidence subject, close reserved work as non-owner, container close with open descendants, summary policy failure) and asserts each thrown BorealError carries gaps whose codes are members of the checked-in enumeration, and that success-path advisory gaps appear where expected. Prefer table-driven tests over one-off cases so new gap codes fail the table until covered. Wire into pnpm test and keep runtime-level (no CLI spawning) for speed, mirroring the style in tests/runtime.

## Evidence

- bw_evidence_918ce40d8c1481c9: passed Validation passed for enforcement-gap coverage leaf: added table-driven coverage for every ENFORCEMENT_GAP_CODES member; hardened file-lock heartbeat/stale-break race needed for pnpm test reliability. Validation commands passed: pnpm check; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/enforcement-gap-coverage.test.ts --testTimeout 10000; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/file-store.test.ts tests/runtime/enforcement-gap-coverage.test.ts --testTimeout 10000; pnpm test (35 files, 339 tests). Git checkpoint attempted but unavailable: git add -- packages/storage/src/file-lock.ts tests/runtime/enforcement-gap-coverage.test.ts failed because .git/index.lock cannot be created, and touch .git/codex-write-test failed Operation not permitted. In-scope dirty paths are packages/storage/src/file-lock.ts and tests/runtime/enforcement-gap-coverage.test.ts. Out-of-scope pre-existing dirty path remains docs/architecture/AUDIT_2026-07-01_ACCOUNTABILITY_AND_AGENT_CONTEXT.md.
